product.description: CĂLĂREŢUL MORŢII este al doilea roman din seria de succes Ultimul regat scrisă de Bernard Cornwell, o cronică a istoriei Angliei de la începuturile sale, „la fel de captivantă ca Urzeala tronurilor, dar inspirată din evenimente reale“ (The Observer), serie care a stat la baza unui excepţional serial de televiziune realizat de BBC. WESSEX, ULTIMUL BASTION englez rămas neînfrânt, este privit cu nesaţ de fioroşii cuceritori vikingi. Legat de pământul ameninţat prin naştere şi căsătorie, dar crescut de invadatorii danezi, Uhtred, un tânăr de viţă nobilă, stă în cumpănă întrebându-se cui ar trebui să-i fie credincios. Dar sângele este destinul său, iar când hoardele vikinge atacă, Uhtred trebuie să lase deoparte ura şi neîncrederea şi să fie alături de apărătorul ţării sale – regele fugar Alfred. BERNARD CORNWELL scrie un roman istoric şi de aventuri excepţional, un roman despre curaj, datorie, devotament, măreţie, dragoste şi luptă, dând viaţă uneia dintre cele mai importante epoci din istoria Angliei.

As Saxon life is threatened by the arrival of Viking invaders and internal conflicts, Uhtredâa young nobleman raised by Danish invadersâfinds himself caught between two worlds. When Viking hordes descend, Uhtred is forced to set aside personal grudges and mistrust, standing alongside the defender of his country: King Alfred.

### About the Series and Author

Bernard Cornwell excels at crafting exceptional historical adventure narratives. This novel is a powerful exploration of courage, duty, devotion, love, and warfare. It breathes life into one of the most pivotal eras in English historyâthe formation of England itself. Fans who enjoyed the epic scope and action of the BBC series are sure to be captivated by these printed pages.

The *Last Kingdom* series offers readers an unparalleled deep dive into a time of constant struggle, cultural collision, and fierce loyalty. Experience the raw energy of life during the Anglo-Saxon period through Uhtred's eyes.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What is this book about?**
*Horseman of Death* is the second novel in Bernard Cornwell's *The Last Kingdom* series, following the life of Uhtred of Bebbanburg during the violent period of Anglo-Saxon conquest by Vikings.

**Is this suitable for history lovers and fantasy fans alike?**
Yes. The book is described as an historical adventure novel that captures the excitement and scale comparable to epic fantasy, while remaining deeply rooted in real historical events concerning early English history.

**Does reading this series require prior knowledge?**
While it is a continuation of a popular saga, the narrative focuses on Uhtred's ongoing struggle for identity and belonging within the volatile political landscape of Wessex.
